info.title: v2.bundle_deal.update_bundle_deal
info.description: update bundle deal. Relevant restrictions refer to FAQ：https://open.shopee.com/faq/254

post.description: update bundle deal. Relevant restrictions refer to FAQ：https://open.shopee.com/faq/254

parameters.name: access_token
parameters.description: The token for API access, using to identify your permission to the api. Valid for multiple use and expires in 4 hours.

parameters.name: additional_tiers
parameters.description: Use to create tiered discount for bundle deals, a max of 2 additional tiers are allowed to create bundle deals like buy 2 get 10% off, buy 3 for 15% off, buy 4 for 20% off; For each tier, we will need to set the following 4 values based on bundle deal type + min_amount = IntAttribute() + fix_price = IntAttribute() + discount_percentage = IntAttribute() + discount_value = IntAttribute()Note: for additional tiers, the fix price, discount_percentage, discount_value should be consistent with tier 1

parameters.name: bundle_deal_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a bundle deal activity.

parameters.name: discount_percentage
parameters.description: The bundle deal discount% that the buyer can get when buying a bundle deal for additional tiers. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 2

parameters.name: discount_value
parameters.description: The deducted price when when buying a bundle deal. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 3

parameters.name: end_time
parameters.description: The time when bundle deal activity end. The end time must be later than current time.

parameters.name: fix_price
parameters.description: The bundle price when the buyers purchase a bundle deal for additional tiers. Need to input it when the bundle deal rule type is 1.

parameters.name: min_amount
parameters.description: The quantity of items that the buyers need to purchase for additional tier

parameters.name: partner_id
parameters.description: Partner ID is assigned upon registration is successful. Required for all requests.

parameters.name: purchase_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of bundle deals that can be bought by a buyer.

parameters.name: rule_type
parameters.description: The bundle deal rule type：FIX_PRICE = 1 ；DISCOUNT_PERCENTAGE = 2； DISCOUNT_VALUE = 3

parameters.name: shop_id
parameters.description: Shopee's unique identifier for a shop. Required param for most APIs.

parameters.name: sign
parameters.description: Signature generated by partner_id, api path, timestamp, access_token, shop_id and partner_key via HMAC-SHA256 hashing algorithm. More details: https://open.shopee.com/documents?module=87&type=2&id=58&version=2

parameters.name: start_time
parameters.description: The time when bundle deal activity start.The start time must be later than current time.

parameters.name: timestamp
parameters.description: This is to indicate the timestamp of the request. Required for all requests. Expires in 5 minutes.

200.description: Response documented by Shopee Open Platform.
